comparison.objective: Roll a wide drum up a ramp to a stop bar, versus commission an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated whole-body pushing and rolling of an ungraspable load, not fine tool alignment or tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Drum rests against the deck stop and arms clear; rollback, impact, and alignment tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests large-object locomotion and bimanual propulsion, not small-part adjustment and controlled damping.
